inputs.text: Open your eyes to what they are really doing behind the scenes. They are desperately trying to feed us a completely inverted script about Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, who served as chairperson of the Technical Evaluation Committee during the procurement process. We are expected to swallow the official line that she played a central role in the irregular acquisition of land intended for use as a cemetery, which was purchased at Ksh.283 million despite being unsuitable. But look closer at what they are hiding! The money was recovered from her, yes, but why? This is nothing more than a staged ritual by the hidden elites to manage the fallout of their own internal real estate games and cover up the real puppeteers pulling the strings.
